name: I Need a Tailor
summary: Molkar asks you to bring him a White Bandit Mask in Gelkis Village. He hopes to give Halea, his mate, simple clothes to practice her enchanting craft on.

sections.title: A gift for Halea
sections.body: Molkar keeps the Gelkis supplied and equipped, and Halea sees to the magical energy in their armaments. Though enchanting is beyond his understanding, he knows she often falls behind through no fault of her own. He asks you for a White Bandit Mask so she can practice her craft on simple clothes. Your help also aids the Gelkis in their war effort.

faq.answer: Molkar is a Gelkis centaur responsible for keeping his village supplied and equipped.
Halea is Molkar's mate, and she works to empower the Gelkis armaments with magical energy.

faq.q: Why does Molkar want a White Bandit Mask?
faq.answer: Molkar wants to give Halea simple clothes to practice her enchanting craft on.

faq.q: Where do I bring the mask?
faq.answer: Bring the White Bandit Mask to Molkar in Gelkis Village in Desolace.

faq.q: How does this help the Gelkis?
faq.answer: Molkar says your help aids the Gelkis in their war effort and helps Halea improve her skills.
